title: Exact restriction and coefficient-isomorphic pullback
statement: For any morphism of commutative ring sheaves, restriction of module scalars preserves finite limits and colimits. A geometric module pullback with invertible structural coefficient map also preserves finite limits and colimits.

source.place: Tags 07A4, 0G7E and 06YU; scalar-unit refinement with sites-modules.tex Tag 03EL; parent proof steps 1–6.

proof.text: Restriction exactness is the finite-limit and finite-colimit conclusion of the ordinary coefficient adjunction theorem.

Lift the algebraic inverse-image presentation across the ULift identifications and apply geometric inverse-image exactness. Scalar extension along the invertible structural coefficient is naturally isomorphic to restriction along its inverse, so the specified pullback is exact by transport.

proof_origin.place: Explicit formalization of the parent scalar/unit refinement of Tags 07A4 and 0G7E.
